messages.subject: Slice1 full controls and provenance review
messages.body: The first complete isolated run finished with 101 executed controls and zero failures, preserving all prior failed smoke attempts and the original false-Passed evidence. A follow-up source review identified the need to capture target-added compiler inputs, so I added an owned per-run MSBuild GetFileHash trace before CoreCompile plus native stage and SDK receipt binding; a fresh positive smoke and full rerun are in progress. Scope remains confined to the exact owned files, with real Cooking gates and final Issue acceptance still NotRun.
